title: The Black Emperor Sect Auction
summary: Xiao Yan's Zong Breaking Pill draws a crowd to the Black Emperor Pavilion. Little Fairy Doctor reveals she is a Dou Zong and drives them back, and Xiao Li, chief of the Xiao Gate, pulls his people away. Xiao Yan finishes the pill and holds off the strong souls that probe his room. Mo Tian Xing, head of the Black Emperor Sect, opens the auction the next day. Xiao Li outbids the mysterious alchemist for the Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler scroll, not knowing the alchemist is his brother. Xiao Yan trades three Fighting Spirit Pills and two Mighty Huang Pills for a Magical Beast carcass that once neared Rank Eight. The Bodhisattva Body Transformation Saliva is the last item, and bidders must make their offers alone in a sealed space.
